subject: phase3_input_cost_containment
statement: Run one bounded historical-control screen on the retained Requests SWE-EVO instance to measure the Phase 3 model-context policy.
selected_option: one repetition of single_codex, agentteam_direct, and agentteam_full under the frozen 4000-token tool-output limit and disabled web search

alternatives.option: select a new SWE-EVO instance immediately
alternatives.rejected_reason: Changing the task would confound the first measurement of the input-cost policy.
It would deliberately repeat the known high-cost behavior; the retained sealed run is sufficient for an engineering screen.
That infrastructure-measurement ceiling is too broad for a cost-containment screen.

rationale: The retained Requests run gives a fixed historical baseline for all three modes. Holding the instance, source, model profile, public inputs, mode order, and evaluator constant provides a bounded engineering estimate of the new context policy. The result remains a historical-control screen rather than a randomized causal estimate.
expected_outcome: Measure whether the context policy reduces provider-reported input cost without reducing official quality, then decide whether to proceed to a new instance.
acceptance_refs: all three launches use tool_output_token_limit=4000 and web_search=disabled
provider usage coverage is 100 percent for every launched invocation
candidate patch compatibility and official evaluator evidence are complete
no corrective operator intervention occurs during a mode execution
the report separates historical-control evidence from strict causal claims
stop before the next mode on identity, usage, resource, or budget evidence failure
